teamMembers.name: Shaibu Issa
teamMembers.title: Founder and Executive Director
teamMembers.bio: Shaibu Issa is the visionary founder and Executive Director of Tanzania Health Alliance. Having personally faced hepatitis B and lost his brother to liver cancer in 2021, Shaibu is driven to ensure no one suffers from preventable diseases due to misinformation, late detection, or stigma. His passion for health advocacy has made him a recognized leader in the fight against hepatitis, HIV, and mental health challenges in Tanzania.

teamMembers.name: Juma Issa
teamMembers.title: Treasurer
teamMembers.bio: Juma Issa manages the financial operations of Tanzania Health Alliance, ensuring resources are effectively allocated to maximize impact on our health programs.

teamMembers.name: Mohammed Nandute
teamMembers.title: Head of Marketing and Publicity
teamMembers.bio: Mohammed leads our communications strategy, ensuring THA's message reaches communities across Tanzania through strategic media partnerships and awareness campaigns.

teamMembers.name: Enock Sichone
teamMembers.title: General Secretary
teamMembers.bio: Enock oversees organizational operations and coordination, ensuring smooth execution of THA's programs and strategic initiatives.

teamMembers.name: Edward Masele
teamMembers.title: Project Coordinator
teamMembers.bio: Edward coordinates our on-the-ground health initiatives, working directly with communities to implement and monitor THA programs.

teamMembers.name: Shuwena H. Ali
teamMembers.title: Associate Director and Administrative Manager
teamMembers.bio: Shuwena provides strategic support in program development and administrative oversight, ensuring THA's operations align with our mission.

coreValues.name: Compassion

coreValues.name: Integrity
